title: Man abducted off a downtown street in Concord

tellings.quote: first there was one a person in conquered California walking in the middle of the downtown streets at 4:00 a.m. had no interest in UFOs but claimed that he had been abducted right off of the street in downtown conquered and and we interviewed him.

plain: In 1976 a man walking through downtown Concord, California, at 4 a.m. said he had been abducted, meaning taken away by beings from a UFO, right off the street. Jeffrey Mishlove, a researcher with a PhD who studies psychic phenomena and UFOs, says the man had no interest in UFOs, and that he and his colleagues interviewed him. Mishlove ties the case to a man named Ted Owens and to a police report, and tells it as one of a string of such cases.
